1.web: Therefore you are without excuse, O man, whoever you are who judge. For in that which you judge another, you condemn yourself. For you who judge practice the same things.
1.asv: Wherefore thou art without excuse, O man, whosoever thou art that judgest: for wherein thou judgest another, thou condemnest thyself; for thou that judgest dost practise the same things.

2.web: We know that the judgment of God is according to truth against those who practice such things.
2.asv: And we know that the judgment of God is according to truth against them that practise such things.

3.web: Do you think this, O man who judges those who practice such things, and do the same, that you will escape the judgment of God?
3.asv: And reckonest thou this, O man, who judgest them that practise such things, and doest the same, that thou shalt escape the judgment of God?

4.web: Or do you despise the riches of his goodness, forbearance, and patience, not knowing that the goodness of God leads you to repentance?
4.asv: Or despisest thou the riches of his goodness and forbearance and longsuffering, not knowing that the goodness of God leadeth thee to repentance?

5.web: But according to your hardness and unrepentant heart you are treasuring up for yourself wrath in the day of wrath, revelation, and of the righteous judgment of God;
5.asv: but after thy hardness and impenitent heart treasurest up for thyself wrath in the day of wrath and revelation of the righteous judgment of God;

6.web: who “will pay back to everyone according to their works:”
6.asv: who will render to every man according to his works:

7.web: to those who by patience in well-doing seek for glory, honor, and incorruptibility, eternal life;
7.asv: to them that by patience in well-doing seek for glory and honor and incorruption, eternal life:

8.web: but to those who are self-seeking, and don’t obey the truth, but obey unrighteousness, will be wrath and indignation,
8.asv: but unto them that are factious, and obey not the truth, but obey unrighteousness, shall be wrath and indignation,

9.web: oppression and anguish, on every soul of man who works evil, to the Jew first, and also to the Greek.
9.asv: tribulation and anguish, upon every soul of man that worketh evil, of the Jew first, and also of the Greek;

10.web: But glory, honor, and peace go to every man who works good, to the Jew first, and also to the Greek.
10.asv: but glory and honor and peace to every man that worketh good, to the Jew first, and also to the Greek:

11.web: For there is no partiality with God.
11.asv: for there is no respect of persons with God.

12.web: For as many as have sinned without law will also perish without the law. As many as have sinned under the law will be judged by the law.
12.asv: For as many as have sinned without the law shall also perish without the law: and as many as have sinned under the law shall be judged by the law;

13.web: For it isn’t the hearers of the law who are righteous before God, but the doers of the law will be justified
13.asv: for not the hearers of the law are just before God, but the doers of the law shall be justified;

14.web: (for when Gentiles who don’t have the law do by nature the things of the law, these, not having the law, are a law to themselves,
14.asv: (for when Gentiles that have not the law do by nature the things of the law, these, not having the law, are the law unto themselves;

15.web: in that they show the work of the law written in their hearts, their conscience testifying with them, and their thoughts among themselves accusing or else excusing them)
15.asv: in that they show the work of the law written in their hearts, their conscience bearing witness therewith, and their thoughts one with another accusing or else excusing them);

16.web: in the day when God will judge the secrets of men, according to my Good News, by Jesus Christ.
16.asv: in the day when God shall judge the secrets of men, according to my gospel, by Jesus Christ.

17.web: Indeed you bear the name of a Jew, and rest on the law, and glory in God,
17.asv: But if thou bearest the name of a Jew, and restest upon the law, and gloriest in God,

18.web: and know his will, and approve the things that are excellent, being instructed out of the law,
18.asv: and knowest his will, and approvest the things that are excellent, being instructed out of the law,

19.web: and are confident that you yourself are a guide of the blind, a light to those who are in darkness,
19.asv: and art confident that thou thyself art a guide of the blind, a light of them that are in darkness,

20.web: a corrector of the foolish, a teacher of babies, having in the law the form of knowledge and of the truth.
20.asv: a corrector of the foolish, a teacher of babes, having in the law the form of knowledge and of the truth;

21.web: You therefore who teach another, don’t you teach yourself? You who preach that a man shouldn’t steal, do you steal?
21.asv: thou therefore that teachest another, teachest thou not thyself? thou that preachest a man should not steal, dost thou steal?

22.web: You who say a man shouldn’t commit adultery. Do you commit adultery? You who abhor idols, do you rob temples?
22.asv: thou that sayest a man should not commit adultery, dost thou commit adultery? thou that abhorrest idols, dost thou rob temples?

23.web: You who glory in the law, through your disobedience of the law do you dishonor God?
23.asv: thou who gloriest in the law, through thy transgression of the law dishonorest thou God?

24.web: For “the name of God is blasphemed among the Gentiles because of you,” just as it is written.
24.asv: For the name of God is blasphemed among the Gentiles because of you, even as it is written.

25.web: For circumcision indeed profits, if you are a doer of the law, but if you are a transgressor of the law, your circumcision has become uncircumcision.
25.asv: For circumcision indeed profiteth, if thou be a doer of the law: but if thou be a transgressor of the law, thy circumcision is become uncircumcision.

26.web: If therefore the uncircumcised keep the ordinances of the law, won’t his uncircumcision be accounted as circumcision?
26.asv: If therefore the uncircumcision keep the ordinances of the law, shall not his uncircumcision be reckoned for circumcision?

27.web: Won’t the uncircumcision which is by nature, if it fulfills the law, judge you, who with the letter and circumcision are a transgressor of the law?
27.asv: and shall not the uncircumcision which is by nature, if it fulfil the law, judge thee, who with the letter and circumcision art a transgressor of the law?

28.web: For he is not a Jew who is one outwardly, neither is that circumcision which is outward in the flesh;
28.asv: For he is not a Jew who is one outwardly; neither is that circumcision which is outward in the flesh:

29.web: but he is a Jew who is one inwardly, and circumcision is that of the heart, in the spirit not in the letter; whose praise is not from men, but from God.
29.asv: but he is a Jew who is one inwardly; and circumcision is that of the heart, in the spirit not in the letter; whose praise is not of men, but of God.
